COWS: severity of opioid withdrawal (11 items).
1. How often do you drink alcohol?
2. How many drinks on a typical drinking day?
3. How often six or more drinks on one occasion?
4. Unable to stop once you had started (last year)?
5. Failed to do what was expected because of drinking?
6. Needed a drink in the morning to get going?
7. Feeling of guilt or remorse after drinking?
8. Unable to remember the night before?
9. Injury to you or others because of drinking? (0/2/4)
10. Others concerned or advised to cut down? (0/2/4)
